data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

## What
Create .github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml — a new GitHub Actions workflow that triggers on push to story/** branches, computes the per-story diff, and runs ci-llm-review-runner.sh.

## Satisfies
- DD1: push to story/<id> triggers workflow, runs ci-llm-review-runner.sh against merge-base(session, story/<id>)..story/<id>
- DD2: concurrency-group expression uses vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID (vars context, not env — env disallowed in concurrency per GHA docs)
- DD3: prior review artifacts downloaded if present (simulates second-push defense reading)

## Workflow design

name: Sprint Story Review
on:
  push:
    branches: ['story/**']
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4 (fetch-depth: 0)
      - name: Fetch session branch
        run: git fetch origin "${{ vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID }}"
      - name: Compute story diff
        run: |
          BASE=$(git merge-base "origin/${{ vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID }}" HEAD)
          git diff "$BASE" HEAD > /tmp/story-diff.patch
      - name: Download prior review artifact (if exists, for cycle tracking)
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4 (ignore if missing)
      - name: Run LLM review
        run: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
        env:
          DSO_CI_REVIEW_DIFF_PATH: /tmp/story-diff.patch
          DSO_CI_REVIEW_DRY_RUN: ... (only when testing)
      - name: Upload review artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

## Files to modify
- .github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml (CREATE)
- tests pass GREEN after this file exists
